items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: once I was talking to him and he told me something that I had in my mind... He says, don't you think, Oman...

ctx.x: Yeah, we wanted to get together.

He was the most, he was a very, very, very charming, interesting person. He was one of these fellows, I never did know too much about his saxophone player, but he knew everything. You could ask him something about what was happening, you know, and one of these kind of fellows, he could tell you everything that was happening and always knew everything. And he knew everything about the New Orleans Rhythm Kings and everything that happened. And once I was talking to him and he told me something that I had in my mind…
